about.title: Loose lines. Expressive colour. Personal stories.
about.p1: I’m Lubina, a contemporary artist and illustrator based in Germany. I have a Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, but art has always been an important part of my life.
about.p2: My work is inspired by architecture, interiors, nature, food, cities and everyday moments. I combine painting with loose pen and ink lines to capture the feeling and story behind a place.
about.p3: I also create custom paintings of special places, homes, wedding venues and meaningful memories.
about.process: Observe → Sketch → Paint → Add the details → Create the story
about.philosophy: I believe that art can preserve a feeling. A building can remind us of a journey. A home can remind us of family. A tree can remind us of a season. A table can remind us of people we love.
about.closing: My work is about capturing those connections and turning them into something tangible.

contact.title: Have a special place in mind?
contact.intro: I’d love to hear its story.
contact.details: To help me understand your idea, you can include photographs, the place’s name or location, what makes it special, your preferred size, whether it’s a gift, and your desired completion date.
